title: chat-audit-pull: renderHtml reads the module-level `let routing` beside its routingById parameter; the source mode is a nullable fromExisting flag; the rows module parses argv and exits on a missing env var when imported
evidence: Found splitting tools/chat-audit-pull.ts (PR 1413). renderHtml (tools/chat-audit-pull.ts) reads main's `let routing` for the fallback stats, which kept it in main; fromExisting (tools/chat-audit-pull-rows.ts) picks pull vs saved JSON and is branched on twice, where one parsed union would do; rows.ts reads process.argv and calls process.exit(1) at import, so an in-process test importing it would exit
